description.value: Black Hills Estate Winery is a premier South Okanagan estate on the Black Sage Bench near Oliver, founded in 1999 and renowned for its flagship Nota Bene red blend, which quickly developed a cult following. The winery has practiced organic and regenerative viticulture since 2020 and features a Wine Experience Centre with panoramic views of Mount Kobau, weekend dining at The Vineyard Kitchen in partnership with acclaimed Chef Jeff Van Geest, and the Vineyard Lodge for overnight stays. Black Sage Road is one of the most popular cycling routes through the South Okanagan wine region, placing this winery directly on many touring cyclists' routes.
